lead: A table the compiler builds and a running program must read does not cross by adding a dependency; it crosses as a second, runtime-side table.
body: `nvs-runtime` is the bottom of the crate tree, so `grep RouteTable` over `crates/` answering "compiler only" is a decision, argued in `nvs_runtime::commands`' module doc § *Why the table is a runtime value at all* and copied by `nvs-cli`'s `runtime_commands` as strings plus one closed enum. Routes, jobs or any later table take that shape; check for the sibling before designing the edge.
